# Settings Guide

Purpose: describe every control in **Settings**, in the order it appears on screen, with its default, when to change it, and what it means for your privacy.

Open Settings with the gear icon at the top right of the **Plan** tab (iPhone), or **Settings** in the sidebar (Mac and iPad). Settings are saved on your device in `settings.json` as soon as you change them. There is no Save button.

Some extra rows appear only in developer (Debug) builds, such as an accuracy-evaluation runner and a navigation switch. They are not in the app you install and are not covered here.

## Privacy

### Allow yearly tax-data updates
- **What it does:** Applies only if you enter your own tax-data feed address (see **Tax data** below). By default the app uses the tax tables built into it (federal 2024 to 2026, states 2025) and makes **no** tax-data requests. With a feed address saved and this on, when you open the app and the last check was never or more than 30 days ago, the app asks that address for five files: `federal_brackets.json`, `state_brackets.json`, `standard_deductions.json`, `capital_gains.json`, and `rmd_table.json`. A downloaded file is saved only if it passes the app's format check, and it then takes priority over the built-in copy. If anything fails, the built-in tables keep working.
- **Default:** On.
- **Which host is contacted:** none by default. Only the address you enter yourself.
- **Change it when:** you have entered a feed address and want to stop the app contacting it (turn this off).
- **Privacy:** a request to your feed address is a plain download. It carries none of your plan data, but that host can see your IP address. Updated tables change the numbers the app calculates.

### Download models over cellular
- **What it does:** Controls whether large AI model downloads may start while you are on a cellular connection. When off and you are on cellular, the app asks "You're on cellular" and lets you choose **Download anyway** or **Cancel** each time.
- **Default:** Off (Wi-Fi recommended).
- **Change it when:** you have an unmetered or generous cellular plan.
- **On Mac** the row is called **Download models on metered connections**.
- **Privacy:** none beyond the download itself (see AI models in [PRIVACY_AND_DATA.md](PRIVACY_AND_DATA.md)). Models are 1.7 to 20.4 GB.

### Require Face ID / passcode
- **What it does:** Locks the app behind Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode (your Mac login password on a Mac). The app stores no PIN of its own; the system checks you. When on, a **Lock after** choice sets how long the app can stay in the background before it asks again: Immediately, 1 minute or 5 minutes. The app also hides its contents in the app switcher.
- **On Mac** the row is called **Require Touch ID / password**.
- **Default:** Off.
- **Change it when:** other people use your device and you want your plan kept private. If no device passcode is set, the lock cannot be used.
- **Privacy:** none. Authentication happens on the device and nothing is sent anywhere.

### Plan data is encrypted (Mac only)
- **What it shows:** On a Mac, a line confirming that your plans, accounts and chats are stored on an encrypted disk image (AES-256), plus whether FileVault is on for the whole disk.
- **Default:** Always on; it cannot be turned off.
- **Change it when:** not applicable. If FileVault is off, consider turning it on in System Settings.
- **Privacy:** the key stays in your Mac's Keychain and is never sent anywhere.

### Network audit log
- **What it does:** Opens a list of the network requests the app has made: host, path, method, result code, size and purpose, newest first, capped at the latest 200. A **Clear** button empties it.
- **Default:** n/a.
- **What is recorded:** the start of each model download (host `huggingface.co`, purpose `model_download`), each tax-data request (purpose `tax_data_update`) if you use your own feed address, and each request to your own model server if you connect one, with a purpose text. A model download is recorded once when it starts, not once per file. The full list of connections is in [PRIVACY_AND_DATA.md](PRIVACY_AND_DATA.md).

A caption under this section says all AI runs on this device by default, and that the only network calls are optional tax-data updates, model downloads you start, and your own model server if you connect one. Every request is listed in the Network audit log.

## Display

### Text size
- **What it does:** Smaller (**A-**) and larger (**A+**) buttons step through 11 sizes: Smaller, Small, **Default**, Large, Larger, Largest, then Accessibility 1 to 5. A preview "Aa" and a row of bars show the current step.
- **Default:** Default (the iOS standard size).
- **Change it when:** text is hard to read. This setting scales text in the app on iPhone and on Mac. On iPad the app follows the system text size instead.
- **Privacy:** none.

## Inference

### Use Apple Intelligence
- **What it does:** Allows advisors to use Apple's on-device language model. If it is off, advisors use a downloaded model instead. If Apple's model is not available on your device, a note says "The Apple model is unavailable" and explains that it needs Apple Intelligence to be enabled.
- **Default:** On.
- **Change it when:** you prefer an open-source model for all advisors, or you want to compare answers.
- **Privacy:** Apple's model runs on the device. The app never uses Private Cloud Compute (Apple's server option); it is off and not selectable.

### Recommended MLX model
- **What it shows:** The model the app recommends for your device's memory, for example "Qwen3.5 4B (Q4)" on an 8 GB iPhone. Read-only. Details in [AI_AND_MODELS.md](AI_AND_MODELS.md).

### Per-agent backend
One row per advisor: Retirement Planner, Tax Consultant, Investment Advisor, Devil's Advocate, Code Generator. (The OCR advisor has no row.) Each has a four-way control:

- **Auto** (default): uses Apple's on-device model when "Use Apple Intelligence" is on and the model is available. Otherwise, if you have downloaded a model, the most recently downloaded one answers. If neither is possible, the chat shows a prompt to download a model.
- **Foundation:** always Apple's on-device model. Greyed out if the Apple model is unavailable.
- **MLX:** always a downloaded model. Greyed out until you have downloaded one. When selected, a menu lets you pick which downloaded model that advisor uses.
- **Server:** always your own model server (see **Your own model server** below). Available once a server is connected.

**Change it when:** one advisor gives poor answers on one model (for example, give the Tax Consultant the largest model you have installed), or you want to compare the two paths.
**Privacy:** Foundation and MLX are on-device. Server sends your questions to the server you connected.

## Your own model server

Lets the advisors use a model that runs on a server you choose: Ollama, LM Studio, or any server that speaks the OpenAI-compatible `/v1` chat API. It sits above **Models** in Settings. A step-by-step setup is in [AI_AND_MODELS.md](AI_AND_MODELS.md).

- **Server type:** choose **Ollama**, **LM Studio** or **Other** (any OpenAI-compatible server). The default addresses are `http://localhost:11434` for Ollama and `http://localhost:1234` for LM Studio.
- **API key (optional):** stored in your device's Keychain and never in your settings or exports. The field is shown for **Other**, or when a key is already set.
- **Connect and test:** checks the server. It shows "Connected - N models - Ollama" (or the server you chose), or a clear error. For Ollama with no models the error tells you to run `ollama pull qwen3:14b`.
- **Recommended for this computer:** a card with **Use <model> for all advisors**.
- **Per-advisor choices:** one toggle for each of Retirement Planner, Tax Consultant, Investment Advisor and Devil's Advocate, each with a model menu. Pick **Recommended** or any model the server lists; models too large for this computer are marked.
- **Test again** re-checks the connection. **Disconnect** removes the server and also stops the automatic Ollama setup.
- **Default:** not connected. On first run the app looks for Ollama at `http://localhost:11434` and, if it finds it, sets it up for you (see [AI_AND_MODELS.md](AI_AND_MODELS.md)). The chat header offers **Use Apple's built-in model instead** to undo it.
- **Change it when:** you already run a larger model than the app can download, or you want to compare answers.
- **Privacy:** requests appear in the **Network audit log**. A local address (`localhost`, `127.x`, `*.local`, `10.x`, `172.16` to `172.31.x`, `192.168.x`) is treated as your own computer or network. Any other address shows a warning that your questions and plan details would be sent to that server. On iPhone and iPad, iOS shows a Local Network permission prompt when a server on the network is used.

## Models

### Manage models
Shows how many models are installed and opens the **Local models** screen:

- A storage card showing installed models and free space.
- A connection banner (Wi-Fi, cellular, offline).
- **Available models:** the models that fit your device, each with its size, a one-line description, and **Download** or **Remove**. A progress label shows Preparing, Downloading with a percentage, and Finalizing; **Installed** appears when done.
- A note that models download from huggingface.co, the only third-party site the app contacts, and that Wi-Fi is recommended.

**Remove** deletes the model's files and forgets it. See [AI_AND_MODELS.md](AI_AND_MODELS.md) for sizes and choosing a model.

### Installed model storage
Lists each model folder on the device with its size and a **Delete** button, plus the same storage card. Use it to free space. Deleting a model removes its files and its entry in the models list.

## Tax data

- **Coverage lines:** the federal years and state years the app currently has, and how many states are included (nine: CA, FL, IL, NJ, NV, NY, PA, TX, WA).
- **View brackets:** opens a viewer where you pick a year, filing status and state and see the federal brackets, standard deduction, capital-gains brackets, state tax, and the RMD divisor table. A note shows when the requested year is not bundled and a nearby year is used.
- **Last check:** when the app last checked for updated tax data ("never" until the first check).
- **Tax-data feed override:** an optional web address of your own. Empty by default, which means no tax-data requests at all. The app requests `<address>/<file>.json` for the five files listed above, about every 30 days when updates are allowed. **Save URL** stores it, **Clear** removes it.
  - **Change it when:** you or your organization host your own reviewed copy of the tax tables.
  - **Privacy:** the address you enter will see your IP address. Only use an address you trust: whoever controls it controls the tax tables the app downloads.
- **Check now:** runs a check immediately and lists each file as unchanged, updated, or error. It is enabled only when a feed address is saved and "Allow yearly tax-data updates" is on.

A caption says: by default the app uses the tax tables built in and makes no tax-data requests; if you enter a feed address, it fetches updated tax data about every 30 days; built-in data is always the fallback.

## Plan

### Edit profile
Opens **Profile**: identity, timeline, spending, Social Security, risk tolerance, and plan management (export, import, duplicate, reset). See [USER_GUIDE.md](USER_GUIDE.md).

## Help & guides

A list of these guides (Quick Start, User Guide, Settings Guide and the others), readable inside the app.

## Your data

### Erase all data...
- **What it does:** After a confirmation ("Erase all data?"), deletes every plan, account, conversation and saved analysis, resets all settings to their defaults (so the setup wizard appears again), clears the network audit log, and deletes the AI models the app downloaded inside its own storage. The app then starts with an empty plan named "My Plan". This cannot be undone.
- **Mac note:** a Hugging Face cache shared with other tools in your home folder (`~/.cache/huggingface`) is **not** touched. Export plans first if you want a copy.
- **Change it when:** you are handing over the device, or want a clean start.

## About & legal

- **Privacy Policy**, **Terms of Use**, **AI Disclaimer:** the full documents, readable in the app, together with other legal documents listed on screen (such as the financial disclaimer and open-source licenses). The first setup screen also links to them.
- **Contact support:** opens an email to wavypix@gmail.com.
